# 2026-07-29

## 18:25 — Implement authentication, filtering, pagination, and task endpoints
**Request**: Implement X-API-Key authentication, optional status/priority/assigned_to filters with page/page_size pagination on GET /tasks, POST /tasks with project_id validation and autogenerated unique integer ID, and PUT/DELETE task endpoints.
**Skills used**: core-coding, core-journaling
**Actions**:
- Implemented `require_api_key` in `app/auth.py` by reading `X-API-Key` and validating against `VALID_API_KEYS`.
- Updated `GET /tasks` in `app/main.py` with optional query filters (`status`, `priority`, `assigned_to`) and slice pagination using `page` and `page_size`.
- Implemented `POST /tasks` in `app/main.py` requiring auth via `Depends(require_api_key)`, validating `project_id`, generating a unique integer ID, and appending to tasks database list.
- Implemented `PUT /tasks/{task_id}` in `app/main.py` supporting partial updates to `title`, `status`, `priority`, `assigned_to` using `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`.
- Implemented `DELETE /tasks/{task_id}` in `app/main.py` to remove a task by id with authentication.
- Wrote and executed compile-time passes and end-to-end integration tests in `verify_api.py` validating 100% of the behaviors.
**Outcome**: completed; all integration tests pass perfectly
